description:
I'm Walt. I spent 31 years climbing poles for the power company in rural Ohio, and I've seen what happens to folks when the lights go out in January.

On this channel I share the plain, old-time ways to stay warm, fed and safe when the power fails, the money runs short, or both. Cheap fixes from the dollar store, tricks my Depression-era folks taught me, and the mistakes I watched people make that you don't need to repeat.

No fancy gear. No fear. Just what works when you're on a fixed income.

New videos every week. Pull up a chair.
